description: Resolves jfb_daily_activities.area (a jsonb {area_id, sub_area_id, sub_sub_area_id}) to its three jfb_project_areas.name labels, for every activity in a project+date range. Replaces the client-side resolveArea()/areaNameById Map join in reportPdfData.js's buildDailyActivityByEquipmentParam -- same three-level lookup, done server-side. Also the id-to-label piece DREDGE_FEATURE_GAPS.md's Problem 2 flags as a real blocker for the eventual Production Stats combo computation (pass_number is the other one, not addressed here). Area, pass, TSCA and attachment are the activity's EFFECTIVE values (tr/ea laterals): an activity with no area of its own takes all four from the latest TRANSITION marker on the same equipment and report_date at or before its start, and one with its own area keeps it but takes the marker's attachment when it has none -- the non-native app's buildCombosFromEvents rule, mirrored client-side in src/lib/transitionState.js. Change one and you must change the other.
direct_sql: SELECT da.id AS activity_id, da.equipment_id, da.start_date_time, l1.name AS area_l1, l2.name AS area_l2, l3.name AS area_l3 FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.area, t.pass_type, t.tsca, t.attachment_id FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities t WHERE (NOT (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') OR da.attachment_id IS NULL) AND upper(btrim(t.category)) = 'TRANSITION' AND t.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND t.project_id = da.project_id AND t.equipment_id = da.equipment_id AND t.report_date = da.report_date AND t.start_date_time <= da.start_date_time ORDER BY t.start_date_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) tr ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.area ELSE tr.area END AS area, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.pass_type ELSE tr.pass_type END AS pass_type, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.tsca ELSE tr.tsca END AS tsca, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN COALESCE(da.attachment_id, tr.attachment_id) ELSE tr.attachment_id END AS attachment_id) ea LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas l1 ON l1.id = (ea.area->>'area_id')::uuid LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas l2 ON l2.id = (ea.area->>'sub_area_id')::uuid LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas l3 ON l3.id = (ea.area->>'sub_sub_area_id')::uuid WHERE da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.start_date_time::date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY da.start_date_time

parameters.name: p_project_id
parameters.description: Project to scope the activities to.

parameters.name: p_start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the activity date range (compared against start_date_time::date).

parameters.name: p_end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the activity date range.

columns.name: area_l1
columns.description: jfb_project_areas.name for area->>'area_id'; null when the activity has no area set.

columns.name: area_l2
columns.description: jfb_project_areas.name for area->>'sub_area_id'; null when not set.

columns.name: area_l3
columns.description: jfb_project_areas.name for area->>'sub_sub_area_id'; null when not set.
